LESSON: CIVIC ENGAGEMENT IN GOVERNANCE - SOCIAL JUSTICE - INTEGRITY PEACE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Developments and Governance
Topic 5.2: Civic Engagement in Governance - Social Justice - Integrity Peace
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Civic Engagement in Governance - Social Justice - Integrity Peace, part of Political Developments and Governance in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we participate in democratic processes in the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign terms related to civil engagement in government,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Civic Engagement in Governance - Social Justice - Integrity Peace in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.
